summary: Solid implementation with strong error handling, clear modularity, and proper CI/CD integration. Functions follow PowerShell conventions well (help, types, error propagation, $ErrorActionPreference). Workflow correctly uses shell: pwsh, action@v4, least-privilege permissions, and proper job sequencing. Minor gaps: no explicit Set-StrictMode in module (PS 5.0+ has implicit but better to be explicit), Get-DependencyLicense loads JSON file on every call (acceptable for mock/test but suboptimal at scale), output format unquoted/unescaped for pipes (edge case). No duplication; design is testable and injectable. Output contracts (RESULT|... SUMMARY|...) are well-defined for CI assertions.
